28506-our-italy.title: Our Italy
28506-our-italy.creator: Unknown
28506-our-italy.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The traveller who descends into Italy by an Alpine pass never forgets the surprise and delight of the transition. In an hour he is whirled down the slopes from the region of eternal snow to the verdure of spring or the ripeness of summer.

53817-the-goddess-of-reason-a-drama-in-f.title: The Goddess Of Reason
53817-the-goddess-of-reason-a-drama-in-f.creator: Mary Johnston
53817-the-goddess-of-reason-a-drama-in-f.description: A book by Mary Johnston. he Château of Morbec in Brittany. A formal garden and a wide  terrace with stone balustrade. In the background the château,  white and peak-roofed, with great arched doors. Beyond it a  distant prospect of a Breton village and of the sea beating  against a dangerous coast. To the left a thick wood, to the right  a perspective of garden alleys, fountains, and flowering trees.

arxiv-1801-03476.title: Schlieren Imaging for the Determination of the Radius of an Excited Rubidium Column Journal: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research
arxiv-1801-03476.creator: A.-M. Bachmann, M. Martyanov, J. Moody, A. Pukhov, P. Muggli
arxiv-1801-03476.description: Abstract AWAKE develops a new plasma wakefield accelerator using the CERN SPS proton bunch as a driver [ 1 ] . The proton bunch propagates through a 10 ​ m 10\,\textnormal{m} long rubidium plasma, induced by an ionizing laser pulse.

arxiv-2111-00575.title: On the Symmetric Difference Property in Difference Sets under Product Construction Thanks: Thank you to Drs. James Davis, John Polhill, and Ken Smith for their counsel and teaching.
arxiv-2111-00575.creator: Andrew Clickard
arxiv-2111-00575.description: Abstract . A ( v , k , λ ) (v,k,\lambda) symmetric design is said to have the symmetric difference property (SDP) if the symmetric difference of any three blocks is either a block or the complement of a block. Symmetric designs fulfilling this property have the nice property of having minimal rank, which makes them interesting to study.

arxiv-2203-08014.title: Non-Existent Moments of Earnings Growth Thanks: First arXiv date: March 15, 2022. We gratefully acknowledge the UK Data Service for granting access to NESPD and their guidance and assistance with regard to this data set. We benefited from useful comments by Stéphane Bonhomme, Giuseppe Cavaliere, Eva
arxiv-2203-08014.creator: Silvia Sarpietro, Yuya Sasaki, Yulong Wang
arxiv-2203-08014.description: Abstract The literature often employs moment-based earnings risk measures like variance, skewness, and kurtosis. However, under heavy-tailed distributions, these moments may not exist in the population. Our empirical analysis reveals that population kurtosis, skewness, and variance often do not exist for the conditional distribution of earnings growth. This challenges moment-based analyses.

arxiv-2303-13859.title: XGC-VQA: A unified video quality assessment model for User, Professionally, and Occupationally-Generated Content
arxiv-2303-13859.creator: Xinhui Huang*, Chunyi Li*, Abdelhak Bentaleb, Roger Zimmermann, and Guangtao Zhai
arxiv-2303-13859.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xinhui Huang*, Chunyi Li*, Abdelhak Bentaleb, Roger Zimmermann, and Guangtao Zhai. With the rapid growth of Internet video data amounts and types, a unified Video Quality Assessment (VQA) is needed to inspire video communication with perceptual quality. To meet the real-time and universal requirements in providing such inspiration, this study proposes a VQA model from a classification of User Generated Content (UGC), Professionally Generated Content (PGC), and Occupationally Generated Content (OGC).

arxiv-2307-01096.title: Combinatorially rich sets in partial semigroups
arxiv-2307-01096.creator: Arpita Ghosh, Neil Hindman
arxiv-2307-01096.description: Abstract . There are several notions of size for semigroups that have natural analogues for partial semigroups. Among these are thick , syndetic , central , piecewise syndetic , IP , J , and the more recently introduced notion of combinatorially rich , abbreviated CR.

arxiv-2311-12462.title: The Frobenius Problem for the Proth Numbers
arxiv-2311-12462.creator: Pranjal Srivastava, Dhara Thakkar
arxiv-2311-12462.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Pranjal Srivastava, Dhara Thakkar. Let n n be a positive integer greater than 2 2 . We define the Proth numerical semigroup , P k ​ ( n ) P_{k}(n) , generated by { k ​ 2 n + i + 1 ∣ i ∈ ℕ } \{k2^{n+i}+1\,\mid\,i\in\mathbb{N}\} , where k k is an odd positive number and k < 2 n k<2^{n} .

arxiv-2312-00721.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Alejandra C. Cáceres-Rigo, Valentin Ferenczi. We extend the methods used by V. Rosendal to obtain the ‘third dichotomy’ in the program of classification of Banach spaces up to subspaces, in order to prove that a Banach space E E with an admissible system of blocks ( 𝒟 E , 𝒜 E ) (\mathcal{D}_{E},\mathcal{A}_{E}) , contains an infinite dimensional subspace with a basis which is either 𝒜 E \mathcal{A}_{E} -tight or 𝒜 E \mathcal{A}_{E} -minimal.

arxiv-2312-13488.title: On the Existence of Parseval Frames for Vector Bundles
arxiv-2312-13488.creator: Samuel A. Ballas, Tom Needham, Clayton Shonkwiler
arxiv-2312-13488.description: Abstract . Frames in finite-dimensional vector spaces are spanning sets of vectors which provide redundant representations of signals. The Parseval frames are particularly useful and important, since they provide a simple reconstruction scheme and are maximally robust against certain types of noise.

arxiv-2403-10488.title: Joint Multimodal Transformer for Emotion Recognition in the Wild
arxiv-2403-10488.creator: Paul Waligora, Haseeb Aslam, Osama Zeeshan, Soufiane Belharbi, Alessandro Lameiras Koerich, Marco Pedersoli, Simon Bacon, Eric Granger
arxiv-2403-10488.description: Abstract Systems for multimodal emotion recognition (MMER) can typically outperform unimodal systems by leveraging the inter- and intra-modal relationships between, e.g., visual, textual, physiological, and auditory modalities. In this paper, an MMER method is proposed that relies on a joint multimodal transformer for fusion with key-based cross-attention.

arxiv-2408-15417.title: Implicit Geometry of Next-token Prediction: From Language Sparsity Patterns to Model Representations
arxiv-2408-15417.creator: Yize Zhao, Tina Behnia, Vala Vakilian & Christos Thrampoulidis Department of Electrical & Computer EngineeringUniversity of British ColumbiaVancouver, Canada {zhaoyize,tina.behnia,vaalaa,cthrampo}@ece.ubc.ca
arxiv-2408-15417.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yize Zhao, Tina Behnia, Vala Vakilian & Christos Thrampoulidis Department of Electrical & Computer EngineeringUniversity of British ColumbiaVancouver, Canada {zhaoyize,tina.behnia,vaalaa,cthrampo}@ece.ubc.ca. Next-token prediction (NTP) over large text corpora has become the go-to paradigm to train large language models. Yet, it remains unclear how NTP influences the mapping of linguistic patterns to geometric properties of the resulting model representations. We frame training of large language models as soft-label classification over sparse probabilistic label vectors, coupled with an analytical approximation that allows unrestricted generation of context embeddings.

arxiv-2409-20108.title: Simple Realizability of Abstract Topological Graphs
arxiv-2409-20108.creator: Giordano Da Lozzo, Walter Didimo, Fabrizio Montecchiani, Miriam Münch, Maurizio Patrignani, Ignaz Rutter
arxiv-2409-20108.description: Abstract An abstract topological graph ( AT-graph ) is a pair A = ( G , 𝒳 ) A=(G,\mathcal{X}) , where G = ( V , E ) G=(V,E) is a graph and 𝒳 ⊆ ( E 2 ) \mathcal{X}\subseteq\binom{E}{2} is a set of pairs of edges of G G .

arxiv-2505-23867.title: Infi-Med: Low-Resource Medical MLLMs with Robust Reasoning Evaluation Corresponding to: hongxia.yang@polyu.edu.hk
arxiv-2505-23867.creator: Zeyu Liu, Zhitian Hou, Yining Di, Kejing Yang, Zhijie Sang, Congkai Xie, Jingwen Yang, Siyuan Liu, Jialu Wang, Chunming Li, Ming Li, Hongxia Yang
arxiv-2505-23867.description: Abstract Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising prospects in healthcare, particularly for addressing complex medical tasks, supporting multidisciplinary treatment (MDT), and enabling personalized precision medicine. However, their practical deployment faces critical challenges in resource efficiency, diagnostic accuracy, clinical considerations, and ethical privacy.

arxiv-2511-10329.title: Curious Case of CGRaBS J0211+1051: Observational Evidence of Lepto-Hadronic Origin of High-Energy Emission? Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2511-10329.creator: Sunil Chandra, Pankaj Kushwaha, Pranjupriya Goswami, Michael Zacharias
arxiv-2511-10329.description: Abstract We present an extensive analysis of the multi-wavelength data of the low-synchrotron-peaked BL Lac object CGRABsJ0211+1051 , which has been gathered over more than ten years with many observatories. Two major γ \gamma -ray flares have been observed during the Fermi era: one in January 2011 and other in June 2019.

europmc-pmc8923208.creator: Suh GA, Lodise TP, Tamma PD, Knisely JM, Alexander J, Aslam S, Barton KD, Bizzell E, Totten KMC, Campbell JL, Chan BK, Cunningham SA, Goodman KE, Greenwood-Quaintance KE, Harris AD, Hesse S, Maresso A, Nussenblatt V, Pride D, Rybak MJ, Sund Z, van Duin D, Van Tyne D, Patel R, Antibacterial Resistance Leadership Group.
europmc-pmc8923208.description: Increasing antimicrobial resistance and medical device-related infections have led to a renewed interest in phage therapy as an alternative or adjunct to conventional antimicrobials. Expanded access and compassionate use cases have risen exponentially but have varied widely in...

pmc-11465011.title: Development of N-alkylated benzimidazole based cubosome hydrogel for topical treatment of burns†
pmc-11465011.creator: Maubashera Nawaz, Sofia Hayat, Umer Farooq, Muhammad Adnan Iqbal, Syed Haroon Khalid, Tan Wen Nee, Kooi Yeong Khaw, Rabia Munir, Muhammad Umar Ijaz
pmc-11465011.description: The current study focuses on assessing the activity of the N-alkylated benzimidazole based cubosomal hydrogel (cubogel) for the topical treatment of burn wounds. The study involves the synthesis of six benzimidazole derivatives (1–6) and their characterization by FT-IR and 1H and 13C NMR spectroscopy.

pmc-11468005.title: Inhibition of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway in pancreatic cancer: is it a worthwhile endeavor?
pmc-11468005.creator: Al Jarroudi Ouissam, Chibani Hind, Brahmi Sami Aziz, Afqir Said
pmc-11468005.description: Pancreatic cancer (PC) is an aggressive disease that is challenging to treat and is associated with a high mortality rate. The most common type of PC is pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC), and the existing treatment options are insufficient for PDAC patients. Due to the complexity and heterogeneity of PDAC, personalized medicine is necessary for effectively treating this illness.

pmc-11667688.title: Inaccurate communication in health sciences: The case of ‘partial artemisinin resistance’ for the treatment of malaria
pmc-11667688.creator: T. Hanscheid, Sara M. Mahomed, Maria Rebelo, Susana Oliveira Henriques, Martin P. Grobusch
pmc-11667688.description: BackgroundAccurate scientific terminology is crucial in health sciences to avoid misinterpretations. The use of ‘artemisinin resistance’ to describe delayed parasite clearance may be inaccurately equated with full resistance, as is typically the case when ‘resistance’ is used with other pathogens, leading to potential confusion.

pmc-12572965.title: spook haploinsufficiency exacerbates aging-related motor impairments
pmc-12572965.creator: Veronica C. Ciliberto, Maya Solis, Carolyne Chepkosgei, Paul Rafael Sabandal, Kyung-An Han
pmc-12572965.description: The global rise in aging populations heightens the risk of motor decline, reducing quality of life and increasing morbidities, yet aging-related motor impairments (AMI) remain poorly understood. Many steroid hormones synthesized by cytochrome P450 enzymes decline with aging but their role in AMI is unclear.

pmc-12591117.title: Electric‐Field Control of Low Damping Constant in Epitaxial Co2FeSi/LiNbO3 Multiferroic Heterostructures
pmc-12591117.creator: Shinya Yamada, Takamasa Usami, Sachio Komori, Yoshio Miura, Kazuto Yamanoi, Yukio Nozaki, Tomoyasu Taniyama, Kohei Hamaya
pmc-12591117.description: To develop electric‐field control of magnetization dynamics in a magnetic material for magnonic devices with low‐energy power consumption operation, an epitaxial half‐metallic Co2FeSi/LiNbO3 multiferroic heterostructure is experimentally demonstrated. The epitaxial Co2FeSi/LiNbO3 multiferroic heterostructure shows a low damping constant (α) of ∼0.006 and the value of α is decreased to ∼0.004 by applying an electric field.

pmc-13023958.title: Biomimetic Response of Zr-2.5Nb Alloy to Artificial Saliva with Variable pH: Corrosion Behavior and Surface Adaptation
pmc-13023958.creator: Viorica Ghisman, Nicoleta Bogatu, Elena Emanuela Herbei, Alina Crina Muresan, Daniela Laura Buruiana
pmc-13023958.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The long-term performance of metallic biomaterials in the oral environment is strongly influenced by their interaction with saliva and its variable chemical conditions. In this study, the biomimetic behavior of a Zr-2.5Nb alloy was investigated during immersion in artificial saliva with acidic, neutral, and alkaline pH for a period of 28 days, aiming to simulate diverse physiological and pathological oral conditions. The evolution of saliva pH was continuously monitored throughout the immersion period to assess the dynamic material–environment interactions.

pmc-13364697.creator: Mohammad Ali Salehinejad, Marzieh Abdi, Mohsen Dadashi, Maryam Habibi, Amir-Homayun Hallajian, Kiomars Sharifi, Ali Khadem, Ricardo Salvador, Giulio Ruffini, Michael A. Nitsche
pmc-13364697.description: Major depressive disorder is a prevalent mental condition and the second most disabling disease. Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), with advantages such as affordability, home-use application, and mild side effects, has been proposed for treating depression. Yet, its clinical efficacy is not established.

pmc-13449363.title: Culture and Leadership Shape the Impact of Private Equity in Emergency Medicine
pmc-13449363.creator: Sara M Gotheridge, Shannon Werb
pmc-13449363.description: The real question is not whether there are guardrails. It is whether organizations can honor them under pressure. For example, Corporate Practice of Medicine (CPOM) was designed to prevent lay control over clinical decision making, yet enforcement has historically been inconsistent.2 Even when formal protections are in place, they do not automatically translate into practice.

(a) Definition.— In this section, the term “nonpecuniary damages” means damages for loss of care, comfort, and companionship.
